title: The ant and Sulaiman
hook: One ant… named in the Qur'an

phrases.text: An ant… whose words are recorded in the Qur'an.
Prophet Sulaiman, peace be upon him, was given a great kingdom, and taught the speech of birds.
His army of jinn, men and birds marched in orderly ranks.
When they came to a valley of ants, one ant called out to the others.
Sulaiman smiled, amused at her words.
And he prayed: my Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour upon me.
A tiny ant cared for her people. A great king answered with gratitude.
Which lesson touched you more? Tell us in the comments.

caption:
One small ant cared for her whole colony 🐜
And a great king answered with gratitude. From Surah An-Naml.
